description: Get raw heart-rate intraday samples for a date. For agent work prefer fitbit_heart_series (agent-safe-series/v1 with hard point caps and exact stats). Personal apps can access their own intraday data; third-party apps may require Fitbit approval. Requires heartrate scope. Not medical advice.

date.description: Date as yyyy-MM-dd or today. ISO date-times are accepted and reduced to the written calendar day.

privacy_mode.description: Optional per-call privacy override. Defaults to FITBIT_PRIVACY_MODE or structured. raw returns upstream Fitbit JSON. summary removes GPS/map details.

name: fitbit_get_heart_intraday
title: Fitbit Heart Rate Intraday
